terbaru.judul: Structure preserving finite element schemes for the Navier-Stokes-Cahn-Hilliard system with degenerate mobility
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work we present two new numerical schemes to approximate the Navier-Stokes-Cahn-Hilliard system with degenerate mobility using finite differences in time and finite elements in space.

terbaru.judul: Linear Numerical Schemes for a $\textbf{Q}$-Tensor System for Nematic Liquid Crystals
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work, we present three linear numerical schemes to model nematic liquid crystals using the Landau-de Gennes $\textbf{Q}$-tensor theory.
